Nango | Staff Backend Engineer, Founding DevRel, Founder's Associate | REMOTE (NA/LATAM/EU) + ONSITE (San Francisco) | Full-time | $140K–$220K + equity

Nango (https://nango.dev) is an open-source platform for product and AI-agent integrations. We handle auth, syncing, and tooling for 900+ APIs so developers can ship integrations in hours instead of weeks. 11k+ stars on GitHub.

Open roles:

- Staff Backend Engineer — REMOTE (North America, LATAM, Europe) | $140K–$220K + equity. Design and scale the backend systems and APIs that power millions of integration runs, and work directly with developer customers on hard integration problems.

- Founding Developer Relations — ONSITE (San Francisco) | $150K–$200K + equity. Build our presence in the AI developer ecosystem: content, conferences, community, partnerships.

- Founder's Associate — ONSITE (San Francisco) | $140K–$180K + equity. Work directly with the founders across strategy, product, ops, and GTM.

Apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Nango
